environment.throughputMethod: Median of three warm encode-only runs over a 512,000-byte UTF-8 prefix; decimal MB/s.

metrics.compression: UTF-8 bytes divided by raw tokens; higher is better.
metrics.fertility: TokLens definition: mean isolated-token count per whitespace-delimited word; lower is better.
metrics.singleTokenRetentionRate: TokLens definition: share of whitespace-delimited words encoded as one isolated token; higher is better.
metrics.normalizedSequenceLength: TokLens definition: raw tokens divided by Unicode code points; lower is better.
metrics.parity: TokLens definition: target-language token count divided by English token count; values near one indicate parity, but corpora are not translations.
metrics.roundTrip: Exact string equality after decode(encode(text)) on all TokenizerBench edge cases.

tokLens.status: metrics reproduced; downstream correlation not rerun

tokenMonster.status: external historical evidence only; not a result for Connor's Tokenizer
tokenMonster.note: The author reports pretraining 16 models with different tokenizers. A comparable Connor's Tokenizer claim requires matched model pretraining and is out of scope for tokenizer-only measurement.
